claims.statement: Delivery locations include web/mobile inbox and verified-address email; shared prerequisite requires email plus platform notification settings. Source later permits email opt-out with web updates; retain tension rather than certify necessary runtime conjunction.

Email read sync needs dual-channel delivery and client image loading from cloud notification sender or GHES administrator-configured no-reply address; this is conditional read-state sync, not accepted review or guaranteed privacy.
Inbox supports bulk triage, Done/is:done, Saved/is:saved, unsubscribe, previews, latest reason labels, custom filters and repository/date grouping; no displayed state proves semantic acceptance.
Email retention can be indefinite only within client storage capacity; web unsaved three-month and indefinite Saved retention remain separate from durable evidence custody.
Cloud watching has a maximum ten thousand repositories; do not generalize threshold to GHES or treat watching count as estate inventory.
Participation through comment/username mention subscribes by default; watching and participating delivery channels are separately configurable with cloud/legacy UI differences.
Absent cloud On GitHub or legacy web/mobile watching/participation settings leaves inbox without updates; email opt-out is described separately, preserving shared-prerequisite tension.
Emails contain HTML/plain-text multipart copies with original formatting; plain-text view is client choice. GHES requires outbound support enabled, not inferred from user preference.

Default activity email can distinguish comments, reviews, pushes and own updates; organization routes may require domain verification and per-repository push emails are a separately linked capability.

Email replies write issue/PR/discussion comments under thread/account identity encoded in reply-to; address validity lasts until password reset. Do not execute replies or expose address as harmless metadata.

Email-reply sanitation attempts standard-address masking and marked signatures/quote removal but is not a guaranteed privacy scrub; unsubscribe link requires signed-in account, attachments excluded and comment maximum65530characters.
Notification settings separately cover participating/watching, Dependabot, cloud-qualified Actions updates and owner deploy-key alerts; parent GHES support does not erase per-capability conditions.
Custom repository events supplement participation/mentions; selecting Issues includes updates on pre-existing issues. This is future subscription scope, not proof of historical notification replay.

Mobile installation automatically opts into web notifications; optional push types include direct mentions, assignment, PR review requests and deployment approval requests. No installation or push authorization performed.
GHES mobile push uses background fetch with possible delay; no immediate alert delivery guarantee or latency SLA inferred.
iOS and Android use distinct notification menu labels and optional custom working-hours toggles; schedule choices require actual delivery verification, not file existence.
Mobile custom event examples are cloud-qualified for issues/PR/discussions, while new releases remain in all-product prose; preserve web/mobile/platform scope distinctions.

Guide supports is:done rather than tutorial is:read claim; existing conflict remains pending independent behavior review. Links and screenshots do not certify full published-version or rights coverage.
